zabbix.description_raw: nvme0n1: Disk read/write request responses are too high
zabbix.expression_expanded: min(/Vibe - Zabbix server/vfs.dev.read.await[nvme0n1],15m) > "{$VFS.DEV.READ.AWAIT.WARN:\"nvme0n1\"}" or min(/Vibe - Zabbix server/vfs.dev.write.await[nvme0n1],15m) > "{$VFS.DEV.WRITE.AWAIT.WARN:\"nvme0n1\"}"
zabbix.event_name: nvme0n1: Disk read/write request responses are too high (read > {$VFS.DEV.READ.AWAIT.WARN:"nvme0n1"} ms for 15m or write > {$VFS.DEV.WRITE.AWAIT.WARN:"nvme0n1"} ms for 15m)
zabbix.comments: This trigger might indicate the disk `nvme0n1` saturation.
zabbix.prototype_description: {#DEVNAME}: Disk read/write request responses are too high

items.name: nvme0n1: Disk read request avg waiting time (r_await)
nvme0n1: Disk write request avg waiting time (w_await)

operational.title: Latencia de disco (I/O) — Zabbix servers
operational.objective: Identificar gargalo de I/O antes que vire lentidao percebida pelo usuario.
symptoms: '<dispositivo>: Disk read/write request responses are too high'
actions: [A DEFINIR] Limite de tolerancia -- I/O alto durante backup costuma ser esperado
operational.meaning: 2 alertas em 2 host(s) do grupo 'Zabbix servers': Vibe - Zabbix server, Vibe - Zabbix-Proxy. Itens `vfs.dev*` medem tempo de resposta de leitura/escrita dos dispositivos. 2 instancia(s): nvme0n1, sda. Severidades: Warning=2.
operational.probable_cause: Disco saturado, concorrencia de processos ou storage compartilhado sob carga.
checks_before_action: Ver se coincide com backup/batch conhecido
Conferir se e disco local ou storage compartilhado
operational.notes: Rascunho tecnico da Fase 2 (confianca high, 2 familias tecnicas). Criterio de resolucao, time, fila e SLA ficam em branco de proposito — sao conhecimento organizacional, nao se deduzem da chave de item. Ver docs/escalation_matrix.md.
